rule_source: https://media.dndbeyond.com/compendium-images/srd/5.2/SRD_CC_v5.2.pdf#page=13 · Playing on a Grid; Natural20 6f294a7 tests/test_map.py
trigger: Step to adjacent square
cost: 5 ft; movement cannot cross solid corners
choices: Eight headings; symmetric connected seeded terrain

trigger: Enter difficult square
choices: Select another path or pay the doubled entry cost

trigger: Trace rays between source and target samples
choices: Distinguish no cover, half cover +2, three-quarters cover +5, and total cover

trigger: Intervening creature's occupied volume overlaps the sight rays
choices: Half cover, takes maximum degree when combined with terrain

rule_source: Arena dimensions and elevation convention; SRD 5.2 pp. 13–14
trigger: It is possible to change elevation using an appropriate movement mode
choices: 10-ft walls, 30-ft ceiling, open air above walls; supported wall tops and a landing surface

trigger: Chosen point defines spell origin
choices: Euclidean radius and line of effect from the origin

trigger: Moonbeam point defines base of cylinder
choices: 5-ft radius, 40-ft height from chosen base, line of effect from origin

trigger: Caster defines origin and chooses a direction
choices: 26 lattice directions; horizontal and vertical cross-section width equals distance along axis; origin excluded

trigger: Caster defines facing for self-originating cube, or selects point for map-centered cube
choices: Forward cube is anchored at center of rear face and excludes that face; point-centered cube uses the square grid alignment

trigger: Requested point effect
cost: No spend until all coordinates resolved
choices: Select row, column and permitted altitude including empty squares; total cover excludes end point

trigger: An area or guessed attack is aimed while foe is hidden
choices: Choose cells without hidden position or hit hints

rule_source: SRD 5.2 pp. 150, 165 · Moonbeam and Spiritual Weapon
trigger: Move an existing field
cost: Action or Bonus Action per effect
choices: Choose point within 60/20 ft of field; positioning from field instead of caster

trigger: Effect originates at a selected point
choices: Aim to a clear point; trace the effect from that exact point rather than a nearby open firing corner

trigger: Source and recipient touch stone
choices: Stone floor is continuous; cardinally connected wall segments share an independent surface; creature touching neither surface cannot be detected through it

trigger: Select visible endpoint within range
cost: One spell slot and Bonus Action
choices: Row, column, altitude; known occupied squares forbidden, hidden occupancy does not change the aim menu

trigger: Select a point on the ground in range
choices: Square on its floor level; airborne cells are excluded

trigger: Touch a stone wall and move along it
cost: 5 ft extra per 5 ft or no extra with Climb Speed; two extra increments when the landing is difficult
choices: Climb vertically, around edge or along wall, with support at floor or wall top

trigger: Move 10 ft immediately before jumping for running range
choices: Direction and distance; without run-up half Strength distance, with run-up full Strength distance; Thief uses Dexterity

trigger: Available height reaches one grid step
cost: The height gained in movement points
choices: 3 + Strength modifier in feet running, half from standing, discretized to five-foot cells; can grab a reachable wall

trigger: Commit a long jump onto difficult terrain
choices: On failure land prone; no extra movement cost for one jump landing

trigger: Voluntary leap out of enemy reach with reaction available
choices: Jump is deferred until the opponent resolves the opportunity window

trigger: One discounted jump per controller turn while spell active
choices: Jump up to 30 ft using spell, or keep charge for a different jump

trigger: An enabled Fly Speed and space ahead
cost: 5 ft of movement per lattice step
choices: Higher/lower altitude and horizontal movement; blocked by walls below wall top; landing by descent avoids falling

trigger: Unsupported and unable to stay aloft
choices: 1d6 bludgeoning per complete 10 ft, then Prone if damage was taken; foot of wall or stone top supports landings

trigger: Monk falls and has an available reaction
choices: Spend reaction to reduce fall damage by 5 × level, or pass; damage reduced to zero avoids prone

trigger: Area or attack reaches a partially covered target
choices: Apply cover to AC or Dexterity saving throws from the relevant origin. Other ability saves receive no cover bonus

trigger: Spider shape touches arena perimeter or ceiling
choices: Choose Spider Wild Shape with merged gear, apply STR 2/DEX 14 and 20-ft walk/climb speed; spend six climbing cells over two turns to reach the arena’s 30-ft ceiling, then walk to the nearby ceiling cell.
